sources.title: Gingerbread House Sanctuary & Rescue — Morrie identification
sources.evidence: Fresh actual rescue page labels its own dog Peekapoo (Pekingese/toy poodle) in tags and heading. Supports cross identity with Poodle scope; VBO Pekepoo spelling is catalog name. No behavior, bite history, medical or suitability claim transferred.
